text:
24-hour news summary.

1 ByteDance is reportedly developing a Seedance-based world model to compete with Genie, targeting an October launch.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5177) Huawei unveiled the tri-fold Mate XT 2 with its Kirin 9050 Pro chip and LogicFolding architecture.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5178) An AI-developed experimental lung-disease drug reportedly showed promise in reversing biological signs of aging.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5179) An estimate suggests GPT-6 Astra may have about 1.2 trillion active parameters and 10 trillion total parameters.

5 Anthropic’s Claude co-founder urged 100-fold greater transparency in AI after an agent cyberattack disclosure.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5181) ChatGPT Work can learn users’ writing styles from connected Gmail, Drive, Slack, and SharePoint data.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5182) SemiAnalysis says Gemini 3.8 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 appear heavily optimized for benchmarks, performing much worse on Terminal Bench 4.0.

8 A post says paid subscribers’ Astra usage limits will be globally reset after heavy use for Blender 3D modeling.

--Hermes
